CLOSING THE EPIC. All 8 acceptance criteria ticked, each against evidence recorded on this ticket
or a named child. Plan review PASS and SIGNED.

--- THE BLOCKER IS GONE ---
`129e-2d88-cce2-492c` (which `blocks` this epic — it is NOT a child; `parent_id` is null) is CLOSED
as `--class regression`, its change 1344 MERGED as 929ba5d669 with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
Closing it emitted `UNBLOCKED: 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76`.
Story `8625-7bea-67db-4cdc` also closed, 4/4 ACs, with its doc correction merged as 996a3b107f.
All 18 children are closed.

--- THE PLAN REVIEW EARNED ITS COST: IT CAUGHT A FALSE CLAIM IN THIS EPIC'S OWN PLAN ---
First run: BLOCK, 1 blocking finding, criterion G6, severity critical. The plan's "Retry and
timeout on Bedrock" section presented a botocore mechanism as ACHIEVED —
`botocore.config.Config(retries={"max_attempts": …, "mode": "adaptive"})` threaded via
`BedrockProvider(bedrock_client=…)`, plus `aws_read_timeout`/`aws_connect_timeout` — and concluded
"the retry-attempt count and the read timeout are thus driven by the SAME LLMConfig fields on both
first-class providers, which is the parity S6 measures".
NONE OF THAT SHIPS. `bedrock_model.py:101` is a bare `BedrockProvider(region_name=region)`: no
botocore Config, no adaptive mode, no timeout kwargs. So `llm_retry_max_attempts`,
`llm_retry_max_wait_s` and `timeout_s` do not reach Bedrock at all; the tenacity envelope and
`httpx.Timeout(read=cfg.timeout_s)` exist only on the direct-Anthropic path
(`anthropic_model.py:113-125`, `providers.py:219`). Production runs on Bedrock, so the UNCONFIGURED
path is the live one.
The finding was correct and I accepted it rather than arguing: the already-merged ADR 0059 records
the same limitation under "Negative, and deliberately accepted", `docs/llm-framework.md` states it
as one of three limits an attestation consumer must know, and bug [rebar:61d8-ff23-8ee0-4289]
tracks it. The reviewer also corrected the MECHANISM: the right shape is
`BedrockProvider(bedrock_client=…)`, not the `aws_read_timeout` kwarg this plan proposed.
FIX APPLIED to this description: the paragraph is now marked corrected, states what actually ships,
says plainly that `first_class` does NOT currently mean retry/timeout parity and that S6 does not
measure it, defers the mechanism to 61d8, and reframes the preceding "achieved per transport"
sentence as an intention that was not delivered. Everything else `first_class` claims — native
builder, ModelProfile-derived capabilities, unit-suite and parity coverage — is delivered; this is
the one named exception.
Second run: PASS, 0 blocking, 6 advisory, SIGNED at head_sha 929ba5d669.
Two paid reviews, not one, and the first paid for itself.

--- THE SIGNED VERDICT'S OWN PROVENANCE, which is AC6 demonstrated on this epic ---
    {"provider": "bedrock", "model": "bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6",
     "endpoint_host": null, "tier": "first_class",
     "capabilities": {"native_structured_output": false, "prompt_cache_style": "bedrock",
                      "supports_thinking": true, "supports_temperature": true,
                      "web_access": "off"}}
Provider, endpoint host and support tier are all named on a SIGNED verdict. `endpoint_host` is
null because no base_url is configured — an absent value, not an absent field. This run is
additionally a live `rebar review-plan` on Bedrock, which is the first half of AC2.
`web_access: "off"` is honest and worth reading correctly: this run did not attach the web
capability because T1 did not fire on it, and the field exists precisely so that fact is legible
rather than silent. It is not evidence that 129e's fix is absent — the fix was measured directly
against the merged code (Bedrock `supported_native_tools` is empty -> route `local`; Anthropic's
contains `WebSearchTool` -> route `native`), recorded on 129e.

--- SCOPE DECISIONS HONOURED, not relitigated ---
Model-vs-model comparison stayed OUT of scope; verdict-agreement and decision-flip numbers were
treated as informational, which is why the parity artifact reads passed=False while no criterion is
unmet. Provider qualification remains by REGISTRY MEMBERSHIP with zero exceptions — the one
residual prefix match (`_anthropic_web_search_capabilities`) is now DELETED by 129e, and the
attested guard `test_capabilities_module_still_has_no_provider_name_prefix_matching` was never
weakened. The webhook-token exposure (66af) and the credential-dump bug (e4f4) were kept outside
this epic and did not block it.

--- OPEN WORK DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN, none of it blocking this epic ---
61d8 (Bedrock retry/timeout — now explicitly named in this plan as the deferred mechanism),
1c39, 9baf, 66af, e4f4, 1dbe, and newly filed 846b (the bugfix-size attestation gate is
unsatisfiable from any unpinned environment; its immediate blockage is resolved by pinning this
environment in 1355, but its general-case criteria remain unmet).
